front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，了解本节训练重点：识别说话人态度（支持/反对/中立/担忧）。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，了解本节训练重点：识别说话人态度（支持/反对/中立/担忧）。

back_content.text: 结论：态度识别 = 通过语气词、情态动词、评价性词汇判断说话者的立场。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：I think the new policy is a step in the right direction, though I do have some reservations about the implementation timeline.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："I think" = 主观判断；"a step in the right direction" = 正面评价；"reservations" = 有所保留。整体态度 = 谨慎支持。② 核心规律：态度词汇层级：强支持（excellent/strongly advocate）> 谨慎支持（good/have reservations）> 中立（depends/unclear）> 怀疑（questionable/doubt）> 反对（opposed/against）。③ 验证与迁移：先定性（正面/负面/中立），再定量（程度强弱），两步确定态度类型。
tips: reservations / concerns / hesitations = 有保留，表示态度不完全正面。
语气词：I think > I believe > I suppose（确信程度递减）；must > should > might（义务程度递减）。

front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话者对该研究结论持什么态度。

back_content.text: 结论：说话者态度 = 怀疑/批评（questionable methodology → 质疑研究可靠性）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：I think what the report overlooks, and this is quite telling, is that the sample size was far too small to draw any meaningful conclusions about the general population.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："overlooks" = 批评研究忽视了重要因素；"far too small" = 强调不足；"any meaningful conclusions" = 否定结论的有效性。② 核心规律：批评性态度信号：overlook / fail to / insufficient / questionable / too limited；说话者用这些词表示对研究质量的不信任。③ 验证与迁移：答案=批评/质疑；选项中"supportive / praising"为干扰项。
tips: 批评态度信号词：overlook / undermine / insufficient / questionable / flawed。
强调词 far too / completely / entirely 配合负面词 = 强烈批评立场。

back_content.text: 结论：说话者态度 = 担忧（concerned）；依据：AI快速发展但监管上未能跟上。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：While I recognize the tremendous potential of artificial intelligence, I am genuinely concerned that the pace of development has outstripped our ability to regulate it effectively.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："While I recognize" = 让步（承认优点）；"genuinely concerned" = 真实担忧；"outstripped our ability to regulate" = 发展速度超过监管能力 = 核心担忧内容。② 核心规律：让步+转折结构中，说话者真实态度在转折后（but/while...I am concerned）。③ 验证与迁移：复述时先说立场（担忧），再说理由（发展速度 > 监管能力）。
tips: while I recognize / although I admire + 转折 = 说话者真实态度在转折后。
genuinely / truly / deeply + 情感词 = 强调态度的真实性和程度。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Frankly speaking, I find the proposed solution overly simplistic. It fails to address the root causes of the problem and could potentially make things worse in the long run.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："Frankly speaking" = 开门见山态度标记；"overly simplistic" = 强烈批评；"fails to address" = 进一步批评；"make things worse" = 预测负面结果。② 核心规律：跟读时注意：frankly + 评价词重读；fails to / overly / potentially = 语气加重，语速稍慢。③ 验证与迁移：跟读后能感受说话者批评立场的语音特征（降调+重读批评词）。
tips: frankly / honestly / to be blunt = 态度标记词，说话者将直接表达立场。

back_content.text: 结论：说话者态度 = 谨慎支持（cautiously supportive）；认可灵活性但担忧团队协作。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Remote working certainly offers greater flexibility, and I support giving employees more autonomy. However, I do worry about the long-term impact on team cohesion and collaborative culture.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："I support" = 正面立场；"I do worry" = 但有担忧；整体 = 谨慎支持（ambivalent）。② 核心规律：however + 担忧词（worry/concern/risk）= 态度有保留；不是简单的"支持"或"反对"。③ 验证与迁移：态度题选项：若有"cautiously supportive / mixed feelings / ambivalent"类选项，通常是正确答案（最精准）。
tips: however / but + worry/concern = 态度转折，从支持转向谨慎。
ambivalent / mixed feelings / cautiously supportive = 描述"既支持又担忧"的精准词汇。

back_content.text: 结论：说话人态度：有保留的认可（appreciate the effort），但整体持怀疑态度（remain unconvinced measures are sufficient）。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：While I appreciate the effort that has gone into this initiative, I remain unconvinced that the proposed measures are sufficient to address the underlying structural issues at stake.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："appreciate the effort" = 正面让步；"remain unconvinced" = 主句否定，真实态度是怀疑/不满意。② 核心规律：CET6 让步 + 主句态度：前面 appreciate/acknowledge = 礼貌让步，主句 unconvinced/skeptical/doubt = 真实立场。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：speaker is skeptical the measures will work，而非 fully supportive。
tips: while I appreciate = 礼貌开场让步，后面的 but/yet/remain = 真实不认同立场。
remain unconvinced = 继续不相信，强调态度持续性；对比 simply unconvinced = 更强。

back_content.text: 结论：说话人持强烈担忧/警告态度：alarming = 令人警觉，对忽视警示信号的后果深感忧虑。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：The latest findings are, frankly, alarming. If we continue to ignore the warning signs, we will be passing on an irreparably damaged environment to our children and grandchildren.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：frankly = 坦率地说（说话人情绪标记词）；alarming = 令人震惊/担忧（强烈负面形容词）。② 核心规律：CET6 情绪态度词：alarming/disturbing/troubling/appalling = 强烈负面态度信号，说话人有强烈关切。③ 验证与迁移：答案：speaker is deeply concerned/alarmed about the consequences of inaction。
tips: frankly/honestly/to be honest = 情绪标记词，后接说话人真实（且强烈）的态度。
alarming/disturbing/troubling = 程度强的担忧类形容词，答案方向含 deeply concerned/shocked。

analysis.text: ① 识别信号：frankly = 坦率地说（说话人情绪标记词）；alarming = 令人震惊/担忧（强烈负面形容词）。② 核心规律：CET6 情绪态度词：alarming/disturbing/troubling/appalling = 强烈负面态度信号，说话人有强烈关切。③ 验证与迁移：答案：speaker is deeply concerned/alarmed about the consequences of inaction。
tips: frankly/honestly/to be honest = 情绪标记词，后接说话人真实（且强烈）的态度。
alarming/disturbing/troubling = 程度强的担忧类形容词，答案方向含 deeply concerned/shocked。

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对城市更新计划效果的隐含态度。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对城市更新计划效果的隐含态度。

back_content.text: 结论：说话人隐含讽刺/失望态度："Interestingly" = 反讽语气，揭示计划未惠及应受益群体，暗示计划失败。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Interestingly, the very communities that were supposed to benefit most from the urban renewal scheme have reported the least improvement in their quality of life after its implementation.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：Interestingly（语气副词）+ "supposed to benefit most" + "reported least improvement" = 词距+反讽结构，暗含失望或讽刺。② 核心规律：CET6 隐含态度：Interestingly/Curiously/Ironically = 可能是反讽，表示说话人觉得结果与预期相悖，态度含批评。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：the scheme failed to benefit those it was designed to help；说话人持讽刺/批评态度。
tips: Interestingly/Ironically/Surprisingly + 与预期相反的结果 = 反讽结构，态度是批评/讽刺。
supposed to = 本应（含隐性失败信号），supposed + actual opposite = 说话人讽刺。

options.text: The speaker believes the urban renewal scheme was a great success.
The speaker is ironically critical of the scheme's failure to help target communities.
The speaker is satisfied that quality of life has improved.
The speaker thinks communities benefited as expected.

audio.transcript: Interestingly, the very communities that were supposed to benefit most from the urban renewal scheme have reported the least improvement in their quality of life after its implementation.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对学生团队的态度。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对学生团队的态度。

back_content.text: 结论：说话人持明确正面/赞赏态度：truly impressive, remarkable composure, analytical depth = 强烈称赞。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：I have to say, the level of preparation demonstrated by the student teams was truly impressive. They navigated some extraordinarily complex problems with remarkable composure and analytical depth.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：truly impressive / remarkable / extraordinary = 褒义强度词，genuinely 强调真诚赞赏。② 核心规律：CET6 正面态度识别：truly/genuinely/remarkably + positive adj = 说话人持明确赞赏态度，不含保留。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：speaker is highly impressed/full of admiration；无让步让步从句 = 态度纯正面。
tips: truly/genuinely/remarkably = 真诚强化副词，后接正面形容词 = 无保留赞赏。
I have to say = 情感标记开场词，引出真实且较强烈的个人评价。

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对当前应对节奏的态度。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对当前应对节奏的态度。

back_content.text: 结论：说话人持批评+敦促态度：complacent = 自满/迟缓，inadequate = 不够，呼吁更高紧迫感。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：It seems to me that we have been far too complacent about the risks involved. The available evidence clearly warrants greater urgency, and our current pace of response is simply inadequate.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：too complacent = 批评当前态度（过于自满）；simply inadequate = 强调当前应对明显不足。② 核心规律：CET6 批评 + 敦促态度：far too + negative adj + greater urgency = 说话人批评现状并呼吁加快行动。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：speaker criticizes current slow response and advocates for more urgent action。
tips: far too + negative adj = 批评过度的负面状态（太过...了）；simply + negative adj = 强烈否定。
warrants greater urgency = 需要更大紧迫性，是呼吁行动的核心信号。

audio.transcript: It seems to me that we have been far too complacent about the risks involved. The available evidence clearly warrants greater urgency, and our current pace of response is simply inadequate.

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对演讲内容本身的态度，以及对听众反应的态度。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，再判断说话人对演讲内容本身的态度，以及对听众反应的态度。

back_content.text: 结论：说话人评价演讲内容：genuinely compelling = 极有说服力（正面）；评价听众反应：rather surprised = 感到惊讶（隐含失望）——双重态度。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：I must admit I was rather surprised by how little the audience seemed to engage with what was, in my view, a genuinely compelling case for comprehensive policy reform.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："in my view" = 说话人个人判断；"genuinely compelling" = 真诚赞美内容；"rather surprised" = 对冷淡反应感到意外（含失望）。② 核心规律：CET6 双重态度题：说话人可对 A（内容）持正面态度，对 B（反应）持否定态度。③ 验证与迁移：答案需区分两个评价对象：content = compelling；audience engagement = disappointing。
tips: in my view = 主观判断标记，后接说话人真实立场。
rather surprised by + 负面状况 = 隐含失望，而非中立惊讶。

audio.transcript: I must admit I was rather surprised by how little the audience seemed to engage with what was, in my view, a genuinely compelling case for comprehensive policy reform.
